12._section_summary: This section reports that ethnic identity (MEIM) was positively associated with body appreciation (BAS), moderately positively related to self-esteem (RSES), and had small positive associations with appearance evaluation (MBSRQ-AE). MEIM scores had small but significant negative associations with Western beauty ideal internalization and with eating, shape, and weight concerns, and were not significantly associated with specific eating-disordered behaviors. Bootstrapped mediation analyses (5,000 resamples) tested Western beauty ideal internalization (SATAQ-3 Internalization-General) as a mediator; it significantly mediated relations between ethnic identity and eating concern, shape concern, and weight concern (95% CIs reported), but did not mediate the relation between ethnic identity and body appreciation.
